blocks.text:
The trip opens in Rio with sweeping views and scenes of city life. From Sugarloaf Mountain and Corcovado, you can see Copacabana, Ipanema, Guanabara Bay, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the surrounding mountains. On Ilha Grande, city sightseeing gives way to time on the water, green islands and a boat trip. The journey ends in Paraty with the story of the gold route from Minas Gerais and a walk through its historic centre, where cobbled streets and old buildings take the place of car traffic.
